fields.Name: AIUsageErrorRateByModel
fields.UserQuestion: What is the error rate and failure frequency for each AI model and vendor?
fields.Description: Per vendor and model: succeeded, failed and abandoned model calls and the resulting error rate, with cancelled and in-flight runs reported separately.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Classifies each non-parent prompt run (no CompletedAt requirement) as Cancelled, InFlight (Pending/Running, started within the last hour), Abandoned (Pending/Running, older than an hour), Failed (Success = 0) or Succeeded, then aggregates by VendorID and ModelID. ErrorRatePct = (Failed + Abandoned) / (Succeeded + Failed + Abandoned). Optional start/end filter the base RunAt column.

fields.Name: start
fields.Description: Optional start date/time filter for prompt runs. Guarded by truthiness check.

fields.Name: end
fields.Description: Optional end date/time filter for prompt runs. Guarded by truthiness check.

fields.Name: VendorID
fields.Description: The identifier of the AI vendor

fields.Name: ModelID
fields.Description: The identifier of the AI model

fields.Name: TotalRuns
fields.Description: Total runs that have completed (Succeeded, Failed, or Abandoned)
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN o.Outcome IN ('Succeeded', 'Failed', 'Abandoned') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: SucceededRuns
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN o.Outcome = 'Succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: FailedRuns
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN o.Outcome = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: AbandonedRuns
fields.Description: Number of abandoned runs (runs that started over an hour ago and never completed)
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN o.Outcome = 'Abandoned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: CancelledRuns
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN o.Outcome = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: InFlightRuns
fields.Description: Number of runs currently executing (started within the last hour and not completed)
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM(CASE WHEN o.Outcome = 'InFlight' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

fields.Name: ErrorRatePct
fields.Description: Percentage of runs that failed or were abandoned out of all completed runs
fields.ComputationDescription: CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Outcome IN ('Failed', 'Abandoned') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.Outcome IN ('Succeeded', 'Failed', 'Abandoned') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DECIMAL(5, 2))
